    assert alternate.read_bytes()==csv_path.read_bytes()

    qa.append({'path':str(image),'sha256':sha(image),'contains_source_pixels':True,'redistribute_in_delivery_archive':False})
for path in paths:
    text=path.read_text()
    assert all(not line.endswith((' ','\t')) for line in text.splitlines()),path

        assert (root/'docs'/target.split('#',1)[0]).resolve().is_file(),target

entries=[entry for entry in entries if Path(entry['log']).name.startswith('calibration-')]
